_cv_text_note: For hosted/remote use you can instead inline your CV as a string in 'cv_text' (below) so no file is needed on disk.
_context_note: Rich freeform context lives in context/*.md (read from disk locally). For hosted use, `npm run pack-config` inlines it here as 'context_text' automatically — you don't edit this by hand.
_cv_pdf_note: Optional: how generate_cv_pdf finds your CV repo (one with scripts/generate-cv-pdf.tsx accepting --json/--out). Local: repo_path (defaults to <repo> when cv_file_path is <repo>/src/cv/cv.ts). Hosted: github_repo, a public 'owner/repo' downloaded at its latest commit. output_dir (local only) defaults to ~/Downloads; the PDF is also uploaded to your Drive.

google_sheets._credentials_note: Local: set service_account_key_file to a path. Hosted: leave it out and provide the key via the GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON env var instead.
google_sheets._docs_folder_note: Optional: Drive folder ID that auto-created application Docs are moved into (leave out to fall back to a folder named docs_folder_name, else your Drive root).

_google_oauth_note: Optional — only needed to AUTO-CREATE Google Docs (a service account can't; it has no Drive quota). Create an OAuth client (type: Desktop app) in Google Cloud, put its client_id/client_secret here, then run `npm run auth` once to fill in refresh_token. Docs get created in YOUR Drive, owned by you. Hosted: provide the whole object via the GOOGLE_OAUTH_JSON env var.
